question: What does the TextWorld ACG dataset contain?
title: Generating Diverse Numbers of Diverse Keyphrases
answer_short: The TextWorld ACG dataset is one of the newly introduced keyphrase generation datasets used to evaluate the proposed recurrent generative model for generating diverse keyphrases.
answer_rationale: The TextWorld ACG dataset is mentioned in the abstract as one of the two newly introduced datasets (alongside StackExchange) used to evaluate the proposed model, which generates diverse keyphrases of variable number. This is explicitly stated in Text 1 [source_id=longrag_0].
